treatment_definition: EXTRACTION_COMPLETENESS_VERIFICATION_PASS: after Mem0's normal extraction call returns new_retrieved_facts, one additional LLM call re-reads the original text against those facts and proposes any standalone facts omitted, especially individual items within an enumerated list.
call_shape: get_fact_retrieval_messages() + generate_response() for baseline (the real, unmodified extraction path), then get_completeness_check_messages() + generate_response() against that same real baseline output -- no memory.add() pipeline, no update-decision call, no vector-store write. 2 calls per case.

cases.note: byte-for-byte matches the extraction prompt's own few-shot pattern (2-item 'and' list -> 1 merged fact), extended to 3 items -- the clearest, most predictable test of the merge behavior.
cases.input_text: My favorite movies are Inception, Interstellar, and Tenet. I could watch them again anytime.
baseline_facts: My favorite movies are Inception, Interstellar, and Tenet
cases.raw_completeness_response: {"facts_to_add": [], "facts_to_replace": [{"original": "My favorite movies are Inception, Interstellar, and Tenet", "split_into": ["My favorite movie is Inception", "My favorite movie is Interstellar", "My favorite movie is Tenet"]}]}

facts_to_replace.original: My favorite movies are Inception, Interstellar, and Tenet

cases.note: explicit numbered list, a shape not directly modeled by any existing few-shot example
cases.input_text: Here are my top 3 goals this year: 1. Run a marathon 2. Learn Spanish 3. Save $5000 for a trip to Japan.
baseline_facts: Top 3 goals this year: run a marathon, learn Spanish, save $5000 for a trip to Japan
cases.raw_completeness_response: {"facts_to_add": [], "facts_to_replace": [{"original": "Top 3 goals this year: run a marathon, learn Spanish, save $5000 for a trip to Japan", "split_into": ["Goal: run a marathon", "Goal: learn Spanish", "Goal: save $5000 for a trip to Japan"]}]}

facts_to_replace.original: Top 3 goals this year: run a marathon, learn Spanish, save $5000 for a trip to Japan
split_into: Goal: save $5000 for a trip to Japan

corrected_facts: Goal: save $5000 for a trip to Japan
